notes.title: Mobocratic Union October Update (1.25)
notes.content:
Get ready for Mobocratic Union October Update! 🎃 With this update, we have a bunch of new features added to the game!

🖥️ Ability to choose the game resolution and support for Windowed Mode
You can now select your game resolution to best fit your computer hardware. Besides that, you can finally switch to windowed mode, making it easier to juggle your political strategies and, among other possibilities, follow the upcoming US election results at the same time!

🔧 Organizational Overhaul!
The wait is over - we finally added the ability to remove organization teams in the Office Page. No longer can you ruin your organizational productivity by accidentally adding an unnecessary team you could not even disband.

🤝 Recruit and Retire!
If you played the game, you probably know the feeling when you enjoy overwhelming public support but still suffer from lack of candidates. Guess what? After our newest update, you're now able to recruit new candidates to your party and... if you really need it, get rid of them. Now that's strategy!

📜 200 New Amendments!
The policy system has been redesigned with 200 new amendments, each crafted with more depth and thought. Get ready for better designed amendment effects and a generally more balanced policy system!

🚨 Early Access Ending Soon!
With this large update, we’re excited to announce the main game now finished! In just a few weeks, we'll officially launch out of Early Access. After launch, we’ll see what’s possible for future additions. The October update is live—let the political games begin!

notes.title: Mobocratic Union August Update (1.2)
notes.content:
Get ready for new experiences with Mobocratic Union with our today released August Update. After updating, there’s a bunch new features awaiting your discovery:

[list]
[*] Ability to write different speeches / political texts and to present them on different medias
[*] Embrace diversity while being able to choose ethnicity for your character. Additionally, AI politicians have also their own ethnical backgrounds
[*] While choosing your party in the beginning of the game, delve into details of renewed ideology quiz. From now on, you’re able to see order of the entire list of political parties, ranked by your quiz answers
[*] See more election details in the Voter Base page
[*] Renewed UI
[/list]

notes.title: Mobocratic Union European Elections 2024 Update
notes.content:
In this update the players of Mobocratic Union receive the possibility to elect the European Commission President. The prospective Presidents propose political programs to the European Parliament which then proceeds to elect the Presidential candidate who gathers enough support from the different European Parliament groups. After the President is elected, the Commission now has a consistent ideology as opposed to the random number generation from before this update. If the Parliament elects a right-wing populist as the Commission President, the Commission starts to propose anti-immigration bills as a result. If they elect a Green politician, the Commission starts to propose bills oriented to environmental protection. And so on.

Below follows a full list of improvements in this version:
- Nomination of the European Commission President and parliamentary vote for President, with the chosen President's ideology affecting the ideology of the future Commission's proposed bills
- Updated map graphics to include visible non-EU countries on the European continent such as Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, Moldova, Turkey, and Georgia
- Changed the color of non-EU countries on the map to "army green" to clearly show that they are neutral, and not governed by the Greens
- Updated UI element coloring scheme
- Updated UI elements to include statistics, voting details, and more
- Revised the tutorial to be more detailed and entertaining
- Added new graphics for character avatars, including changing the blue eye color to a more natural one and adding new backgrounds

Be a Mobocrat, better than ever before!

notes.title: Mobocratic Union June Update
notes.content:
Introducing the new and improved European continent map. We completely redrew the map from the ground up with higher detail and more respect for geography. We enhanced the MU map engine by allowing the addition of islands as part of countries, making it possible to include Åland, Sardinia, and the Balearic Islands, among others, on the map.

The update also includes improvements in elections. Now there is a text field called "total votes counted" that shows the percentage of votes counted so far in the elections. Additionally, some performance improvements have been made. We have added improvements to the sound controls dashboard.

A member of the community, Aavikko, has created new amendments focusing on EU agricultural policy. These have been added to the game and can be activated or disabled in the amendments menu.

We hope you enjoy the improvements! Stay tuned for news!

notes.title: Get ready for MUNFU! Mobocratic Union Next Fest Update (Beta 0.85) is out
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Experience unique and personalized avatars with our newly designed hand-drawn graphics. Our procedural, paper-doll-like system generates a vast variety of avatars for both players and NPCs.
[*] Get a revamped organization view that visualizes the different factors impacting your organization's effectiveness. Now, easily grasp the bars that represent these factors.
[*] Stay updated with the latest committee view enhancements. Discover the exact person who proposed a new amendment, along with their party affiliation.
[*] Enjoy the fresh graphics available in the Steam library.
[*] We value your feedback! Introducing a new feedback button that supplements the already existing feedback quiz upon exiting the game.
[*] Explore the updated Mobopedia, brimming with new articles for getting you started in the game.
[*] The latest two updates change the visuals of the game and if you have played a prior version of the game we heavily recommend you test out the latest version! We believe much progress has been made and the game is clearly improving
[/list]

notes.title: Mobocratic Union January Update (Beta 0.84)
notes.content:
Happy new year to all our fellow mobocrats!

Today, we're glad to announce the newest the Mobocratic Union January Update, which includes many new, intriguing new features. Let's take a look, shall we?

[list]
[*] New background graphics for the MEPs office, news studio and country page
[*] UI improvements: verbalized and visualized ideological descriptions of policy proposals and visualization of relative influence between characters
[*] Inbuilt Mobopedia with articles on how to play the game and explanations on how the different systems in the game work
[*] Some easter eggs... As Aristotle said: "Those who know, know." Others, let's figure out!
[*] A system for activating and inactivating amendments based on thematic amendment packs
[*] Several bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Mobocratic Union Mid-December Update (Beta 0.82)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adding amendments to proposals now costs Prestige Points, therefore increasing the importance of good staff planning skills!
[*] The Council of European Union now sends back counter-proposals to the European Parliament, if it does not approve the original proposals
[*] Other improvements, including small UI improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Mobocratic Union December Mini-Update (Beta 0.81) Is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings political gaming enthusiasts! It has been a mere month since our last update, and today, we proudly present to you the December edition of Mobocratic Union. Prepare yourselves for an electrifying array of enhancements that will undoubtedly amplify your political prowess:
[list]
[*] Behold the improvements bestowed upon the character screen user interface, making it easier to focus on the relevant information and being more economical with screen real estate
[*] Immerse yourself in the captivating visual panorama of character avatars, as we unleash an arsenal of over 100 brand-new graphic files. Witness your beloved virtual politicians come to life in breathtaking detail
[*] Fear not, for we have eradicated a pesky bug that once plagued the national seat distribution grap
[*] As the tumultuous moment arrives, indulge your senses in the exquisite symphony of sound effects now harmoniously synchronized with the pivotal voting events. Be transported into the very heart of democracy, where each decision reverberates with palpable consequence.
[/list]
We are confident that these refinements elevate your Mobocratic Union experience to new heights. 
Rest assured, dear enthusiasts, for this is but a taste of the bountiful updates that await you in the ever-unfolding future.

notes.title: Mobocratic Union November Update (Beta 0.8)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to choose a gender in the politician creator view.
[*] Improved the country view by displaying political party support with a bar chart and showing the graphical distribution of elected seats by their party holders.
[*] Added 17 new amendments with themes related to immigration, constitutional rights, and agriculture.
[*] Added 25 new amendments focusing on criminal justice reform and national defense.
[*] Alphabetically arranged the EU member countries list in the character generation menu.
[*] Added more descriptive country descriptions in the upper right corner of the country overview section.
[*] Introduced 30 Finnish language male first names and 30 female first names.
[*] Rewrote one of the start questionnaire questions to ensure that the alternatives fit into symmetrical and appealing buttons.
[*] Improved dialogue in the team management system.
[/list]
